_about: How the world is lit and graded on screen (task L1, docs/design/look.md). Unreal side only: the sim never reads this. Light is in real-world units (lux); the camera's exposure is in EV100.

exposure._about: The camera is held near a target that follows the light: noonEV at a clear midsummer noon, and for every stop darker the scene is, the target drops `follow` stops (1 would make night as bright as day). The auto exposure may move `brighterEV` below and `darkerEV` above the target, for rooms and bright snow.

fog._about: Height fog: the density follows the weather's sight factor (as before); its colour is the sky atmosphere's, with a grey (or snow-white) veil mixed in as the sky clouds over. Volumetric fog makes light shafts; morning and evening mist thickens it while the sun is low.

morningMist._about: Ground mist, the height fog's second layer: it gathers from fromHour, is thickest at peakHour (about dawn) and has burnt off by toHour; a little (evening share) comes back after dusk. Every morning gets baseShare of it and wet ground (after rain) adds up to afterRain more; falling rain or snow clears it. density uses the fog's units (0.3 is a mist you cannot see 50 m through); heightFalloff makes it a low layer (1.0: halves about every 8 m); heightOffsetCm lifts it.

stars._about: The night sky: NASA's Deep Star Maps 2020 (tools/sky_textures.py, SkyArt commandlet) on a dome round the camera. brightness multiplies the map (its Milky Way is about 0.03, so 0.6 gives a faint band as a dark-sky site shows it); latitudeDeg is the colony's latitude (the tropics: near the equator, so the sky turns overhead); cloudCut is how much cloud hides them.

film._about: The engine's filmic tone curve, at its neutral defaults, then a small lift.

seasons._about: One colour grade per season, blended between the seasons' middle days (the sim's year is 60 days: spring 0 to 15, summer to 30, autumn to 45, winter to 60). white is the white balance in kelvin (6500 neutral; lower looks colder, higher warmer).

groundCover._about: Cosmetic ground cover (task L2, docs/design/terrain.md): low leafy tufts and dead leaves on open fertile soil, never sim plants. Each cell tries perCell times; a try succeeds with chancePoor at minFertility up to chanceRich on rich soil (fertility 1.4), times underPlants where a sim plant grows, times the Terrain.GroundCover console value. Meshes are scaled to fitHeight metres; drawn out to cullDistance metres; leaves move in the wind out to windDistance metres.

quality._about: Look.Quality 0 Low, 1 Medium, 2 High (default), 3 Epic. scalability is the engine's quality level for every group (Lumen global illumination and reflections need 2 or more); the rest are ours.
